about: Broken copies of real content, one rule each, for tools/test_broken.py. Each case edits files as they are today (JSON Pointer paths) and says which checks must fail; every other check must pass. needs_built_models: the case is skipped until tools/build_model.sh has built the models.

cases.name: fox_unknown_archetype
cases.why: The archetype must be a key in animals/archetypes.json.

cases.name: squirrel_playable_text
cases.why: A playable animal needs every REQUIRED_PLAYABLE text.

cases.name: moose_intro
cases.why: A playable animal needs intro, or all three intro_<mode> texts.

cases.name: fox_dark_vision
cases.why: dark_vision is a number from 0 to 1.

cases.name: vole_digs_text
cases.why: An animal that digs needs a dig text.

cases.name: kestrel_safe_tag
cases.why: A playable hunter needs safe_tag.

cases.name: fox_territorial_text
cases.why: A territorial animal needs rival_bite and rival_caught_you.

cases.name: kestrel_bite_text
cases.why: A hunter needs bite and caught_you.

cases.name: perch_rain_message
cases.why: An animal rain doesn't chill is never told to find shelter from it.

cases.name: fox_model_path
cases.why: model.file is res://assets/animals/<id>.glb.

cases.name: fox_model_missing
cases.why: model.file must be built.

cases.name: fox_no_year
cases.why: Every animal has a year section.

cases.name: fox_year_winter
cases.why: year.winter is active, hibernates or migrates.

cases.name: bee_hibernation_date
cases.why: Hibernation dates are month-day.

cases.name: chaffinch_no_migration
cases.why: A migrating animal gives its migration dates.

cases.name: fox_year_food
cases.why: year.food says what it eats in every season.

cases.name: fox_baby_scale
cases.why: family.baby_scale is from 0.2 to 0.9.

cases.name: fox_family_lessons
cases.why: family.lessons are eat, pounce, shelter and sleep.

cases.name: fox_pounce_without_hunting
cases.why: The pounce lesson needs an animal that hunts.

cases.name: fox_family_text
cases.why: A family needs a text for each lesson.

cases.name: fox_move
cases.why: move is ground, fly or swim.

cases.name: moose_shelter
cases.why: shelter is one of the shelters the game knows.

cases.name: region_unknown_playable
cases.why: A region's playable animals have files.

cases.name: region_no_cones
cases.why: Every diet food kind is in the region (decision 0011).

cases.name: region_no_lizard
cases.why: Every hunts tag belongs to another animal in the region.

cases.name: bee_eats_nothing
cases.why: Every animal has a diet or hunts.

cases.name: fi_placeholder
cases.why: A translation uses the same placeholders as English.

cases.name: fi_unknown_key
cases.why: A translated key exists in English.

cases.name: fi_invalid_json
cases.why: Locale files are valid JSON.

cases.name: vole_glb_missing
cases.why: Every animal model is built.

cases.name: vole_glb_no_sleep
cases.why: A built animal has every clip: idle, walk, run, eat, sleep.

cases.name: vole_glb_no_skeleton
cases.why: A built animal has a skeleton.

cases.name: bilberry_id
cases.why: A plant's id equals its file name.

cases.name: bilberry_latin
cases.why: latin is a scientific name.

cases.name: plant_duplicate_species
cases.why: One species, one spec.

cases.name: bilberry_sources
cases.why: A plant lists its sources.

cases.name: bilberry_kind
cases.why: kind is ground or bush.

cases.name: bilberry_no_year
cases.why: A plant has a year section.

cases.name: bilberry_leaves_no_show
cases.why: A plant that drops its leaves has parts with show.

cases.name: bilberry_show_format
cases.why: show is two season marks like summer+50.

cases.name: bilberry_season_name
cases.why: seasons are spring, summer, autumn and winter.

cases.name: bilberry_season_colour
cases.why: A seasonal colour changes a colour in colors.

cases.name: bilberry_no_preview
cases.why: A plant has its preview sheet.

cases.name: bilberry_glb_missing
cases.why: A plant is built.

cases.name: bilberry_no_triangles
cases.why: A plant has triangles on at least one of four dates.

cases.name: bilberry_more_parts_built
cases.why: The built model has no more parts than the spec.

cases.name: region_bad_colour
cases.why: Colours are #rrggbb.

cases.name: region_unknown_key
cases.why: A region has no keys the game doesn't know.

cases.name: region_status
cases.why: status is draft, reviewed or released.

cases.name: region_explored_sources
cases.why: An explored place has at least 3 sources.

cases.name: fox_unknown_key
cases.why: An animal has no keys the game doesn't know.

cases.name: fox_text_too_long
cases.why: Texts stay short enough for the screen.

cases.name: fox_model_shape
cases.why: A part's shape is one build_model.py knows.

cases.name: fox_part_colour
cases.why: A part's colour is in colors.

cases.name: archetype_extends
cases.why: An archetype extends one in the same file.

cases.name: wanted_status
cases.why: A wanted row's status is wanted, in_progress, check or later.

cases.name: chanterelle_top_typo
cases.why: A plant taper's top is at most 10, so a typo like 45 for 4.5 is caught.

cases.name: red_fox_copy_of_fox
cases.why: One real species, one file: a copy of fox under another id is the same species (GBIF taxon).

cases.name: fox_without_taxon
cases.why: Every animal file says which real species it is.

cases.name: heather_latin_not_taxon
cases.why: A plant's latin is its taxon's accepted name.

cases.name: young_perch_not_a_stage
cases.why: young_perch is the same species as perch, so it must say it is a stage of it.

cases.name: young_perch_stage_of_nothing
cases.why: stage_of names an existing animal file.

cases.name: young_roach_stage_of_perch
cases.why: stage_of names a file of the same species.

cases.name: bilberry_copy_of_heather_taxon
cases.why: Two plant specs can't be the same species.

cases.name: nuuksio_poisonous_food
cases.why: A plant on poisonous-plants.json can never be food (spec 07).

cases.name: saimaa_frozen_shut
cases.why: Frozen water must leave open water for swimmers: cover is at most 0.9.

cases.name: nuuksio_cave_riddled
cases.why: Caves are at most 0.3 of the rock: more would leave hills hollow.
